title: Account Intelligence, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Account Intelligence workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 1 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map list.
steps.expected: 8 fictional records, including Sarah Chen (AcmeStakeholderMapId Sarah Chen), with Role CTO.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Account Intelligence Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 6 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 1 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Account Executive
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare a synthetic Acme Corporation account overview and show the evidence that deserves seller attention.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Account Overview; Account Health Score; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Stakeholder Map; Relationship Gaps; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Account Intelligence: 1 read-only tabs from the same lists. 8 fictional records, including Sarah Chen (AcmeStakeholderMapId Sarah Chen), with Role CTO.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload acme-stakeholder-map.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AcmeStakeholderMapId, Role, Influence, Sentiment, Meetings, ExactSyntheticNotes to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 8 fictional records, including Sarah Chen (AcmeStakeholderMapId Sarah Chen), with Role CTO.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Account Intelligence Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Account Intelligence Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the one list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_account-intelligence-operating-rules.md, aibast_account-intelligence-synthetic-records.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the acme stakeholder map tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map; name the tool Get acme stakeholder map records.
steps.expected: Get acme stakeholder map records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 6 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 6 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 6 skills, the rules knowledge and 1 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 6 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 1 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: account-intelligence-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 1 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Account Intelligence Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 1 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Account Intelligence Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Account Intelligence Acme Stakeholder Map tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 8 fictional records, including Sarah Chen (AcmeStakeholderMapId Sarah Chen), with Role CTO.
